nodes.label: OKLCH palette composition strategy (bg/surface/ink/accent/muted)
nodes.rationale: Mood lives in brand colors (primary+accent) and typography, not surface; pure white/black bg defaults avoid the 'AI cliché' of warming both primary and bg. Hue-bucket inverse-frequency weighting in buildWeights ensures fair rainbow exposure despite a red/orange-skewed curated seed library.

nodes.label: Degradation table by breakpoint (Three.js, parallax, hover preview, cursor, WhatsApp button)
nodes.rationale: Below 768px, Three.js hero is replaced by a static image, parallax disabled, hover previews become tap-to-reveal, custom cursor hidden, and WhatsApp button becomes sticky bottom-right — to keep mobile performant and touch-usable.
